name: Hogusu Physio
description: A clean, serene and modern health theme for a small neighbourhood physiotherapy clinic in a fictional town. Sea-glass mist pages, a pale sea-glass wash for panels, deep sea ink for text and one muted deep teal for lines, dots and numerals; Wix Madefor Display for headings over Wix Madefor Text. The hero and the chapter pictures are continuous single-line drawings (raster WebP; one unbroken deep-teal stroke per figure). Every page opens with a two-tier header (H9): a utility strip with today's hours and the phone number over the main bar with the menu and a "Book an assessment" pill. The home page is a single-column long read (L7) that walks through one first appointment in four chapters - assessment, hands-on, exercises, follow-up - each one row with its number on a dotted rail and a line drawing, then fees, the team and the journal. The footer is a quiet "Book an assessment" band over the clinic details and a small sitemap (F7). Pages: Treatments, Your first visit, Fees, Team, Journal, Newsletter and Contact. Hours, phone and address are edited once in Appearance > Clinic details; the locator card and the fees table are synced patterns.

summary.en: A calm site for a small physiotherapy clinic: single-line drawings walk through a first visit, from assessment to follow-up.

summary.fr: Un site calme pour un petit cabinet de kinésithérapie : des dessins d’un seul trait racontent la première visite, du bilan au suivi.
summary.de: Eine ruhige Website für eine kleine Physiotherapiepraxis: Einstrich-Zeichnungen führen durch den ersten Termin, vom Befund bis zur Nachkontrolle.

deviation: Codes: none (H9 + F7 + L7 as planned; combination unused: Mimi Veterinary is H9/F7/L10, Yuge Sento H7/F6/L7). Neighbours: Nijimi Tenugui (H10/F8/L13, blue light) and Yoru Chocolate share no code or palette family. Palette as planned (sea-glass mist #EFF3F2, wash #D8E3E1, deep sea ink #1F3330, muted deep teal #4F7C76) plus deep teal #355C56 for small links (6.7:1 on mist / 5.7:1 on wash), slate teal #4A5E5B for quiet text (6.2:1 / 5.3:1) and paper cards #F8FAF9; muted teal #4F7C76 (4.2:1) is for lines, dots, numerals and large type only. Fonts verified against google/fonts OFL.txt: Wix Madefor Display and Wix Madefor Text are OFL-1.1 without a Reserved Font Name; shipped as the unmodified upstream variable TTFs (wght 400-800) because no subsetting toolchain was available this round. Industry physiotherapy is new. Built from the Mimi Veterinary structure (same H9 utility strip + F7 band), with a new L7 single-column home. 4 raster single-line illustrations (WebP, Grok Build image_gen via scripts/grok-image.sh), checked by eye for text and logos; team members are text cards without portraits (image budget).
